query: daemon silent fail v4 four-layer gate
memoryEntries: The relvetia-daemon silent-fail incident was resolved in v4 by introducing a four-layer gate: (1) PreToolUse hook, (2) writer contract, (3) verify-runner postcondition, (4) handoff completion stamp. Prior versions could silently exit without writing .last-distill, leaving the scheduler convinced distillation was still pending and re-firing indefinitely.
